annotation.title_clean: 国家知识产权局 海关总署关于强化知识产权协同保护的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the China National Intellectual Property Administration and the General Administration of Customs on Strengthening Coordinated Intellectual Property Protection
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家知识产权局; 海关总署
annotation.summary_en: Joint opinion of China's National Intellectual Property Administration and Customs Administration on coordinating IP protection: data sharing, investigation assistance, enforcement standards, key-sector customs recordal, joint research, training and evaluation. AI is mentioned only as a tool for IP enforcement.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establish long-term data-sharing mechanism between CNIPA and Customs on trademarks and patents
Customs and IP offices assist each other in investigations, including technical investigators
Unify infringement-judgment standards via shared administrative rulings
Encourage customs recordal for well-known trademarks, geographical indications and photovoltaic firms
Joint research on applying AI and big data to IP protection, training, and evaluation
